capabilities: Organize existing tags into custom groups and blocks
Reorder and move tags with drag and drop
Sort tags and groups by name or usage frequency
Rename tags across Markdown content and YAML tag lists
disambiguation: Grouping is stored in the plugin's own data; only the rename action modifies tags in notes or YAML frontmatter.
extras: The README warns that renaming tags modifies vault files and advises backing up or using version control first. The plugin stores organization data locally in data.json and sends no telemetry.
problem: Obsidian's tags view lists tags flatly, with no way to visually organize related tags into custom groups for large tag collections.
summary: Tag manager view that arranges existing vault tags into custom groups and blocks without changing the tags in your notes.
